integration.scope: Includes contemporaneous browser lifetime and streaming body controls; final archives require resealing and separate qualification.

limits: One opaque sessionStorage marker, no private payload and no automatic POST retry. This is conservative client-side uncertainty tracking, not backend idempotency or a transactional cross-process lock.
Storage read/write failure refuses enhanced POST before transmission. Known response and explicit status resolution clear only a matching marker; legacy marker1 is recognized.
A genuinely missing storage marker does not imply server rollback; explicit application status evidence is still required for an uncertain current document.
